definitions.explanation: Something undesirable happening frequently or in quick succession. Typically used for accidents, incidents, disasters, or problems.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}が{頻発|ひんぱつ}している。
この{交差点|こうさてん}では{交通|こうつう}{事故|じこ}が{頻発|ひんぱつ}している。
examples.english: Traffic accidents occur frequently at this intersection.

examples.japanese: {近年|きんねん}、{異常|いじょう}{気象|きしょう}による{自然|しぜん}{災害|さいがい}が{頻発|ひんぱつ}しており、{対策|たいさく}が{急|きゅう}がれている。
examples.english: In recent years, natural disasters caused by abnormal weather have been occurring frequently, and countermeasures are urgently needed.

notes:
Almost exclusively used for negative events — accidents, crimes, disasters, problems. Would not normally be used for positive occurrences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事故|じこ}が{頻発|ひんぱつ}する (accidents occur frequently)
- {犯罪|はんざい}が{頻発|ひんぱつ}する (crimes occur frequently)
- {災害|さいがい}が{頻発|ひんぱつ}する (disasters occur frequently)
- トラブルが{頻発|ひんぱつ}する (problems occur frequently)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {多発|たはつ} also means frequent occurrence but is slightly more neutral
- {頻繁|ひんぱん} (frequent) is an adjective and applies to both positive and negative things
